coupled.scope: tagged-site-only sensitivity in the full PdD cell; NOT an all-cell refit
coupled.sampling: source joint old homogeneous PdD primitive paths; mass, graph, box and host Hamiltonian held fixed; host distribution may respond through joint reweighting
coupled.weight: one frame weight exp[-beta mean_beads(V_new(x)-V_old(x))] on all retained beads; neighbor and spring terms cancel; archived all-cell alternate weights are not used
coupled.position: direct joint bead marginal, f(r)=dP/dr; empty bins mean unobserved, not physical zeros; shell-averaged spatial density is shell probability divided by shell volume
coupled.support: 0.24 Å is the old nominal directional extent; 0.48 Å is the new maximum signed ray radius, NOT a validated ball; even some interior off-axis points and every exterior prediction rely on continuation. 0.60/0.80 Å are diagnostics, not data limits.
coupled.uncertainty: paired ratio influence SE across nine equal contiguous time blocks; not a formal confidence interval or a correction for remaining correlations. Frame ESS and block ESS measure sampled weight participation only. No P extrapolation, PES uncertainty or unseen-overlap guarantee.
coupled.momentum: existing exact finite-P midpoint displaced-path characteristic in signed [111] component, with the actual co-beaded graph field, deuteron mass, four cuts and antithetic signs. Separation is conjugate to k=p/hbar; no coordinate-to-k cutoff, Gaussian momentum or dynamics.
